description.text: Starter Set V Grass, one of five 60-card decks, one for each of five types, released together on 29 November 2019, a week before Sword and Shield, the first expansions of the Sword & Shield series. It is led by Celebi V, with Grookey and its evolutions Thwackey and Rillaboom, the Galar region's Grass starter, and like the other four it holds the Supporters Hop and Marnie from Pokémon Sword and Shield. Each came with a sheet of damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat and a how-to-play guide. The five decks were also sold together in the Starter Set V5 Complete Battle Box, with a special box and ball for picking a deck.
